title: Future Video Generation Better Aligns with the Human Visual Cortex than Observed Video
abstract: arXiv:2609.38819v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Studying the alignment between the internal representations of vision models and the responses of the visual cortex to the same observed visual stimuli has enabled us to better understand human visual processing. However, studies so far have largely overlooked the fact that the human brain not only processes observed visual stimuli, but also predicts upcoming stimuli based on what has been observed. Accordingly, we hypothesize that internal representations for generating future video frames are better aligned with the predictive nature of human visual processing than representations of the observed video itself. translated_title: 未来视频生成比观察到的视频更好地与人类视觉皮层对齐
translated_abstract: 研究视觉模型的内部表示与视觉皮层对相同观察到的视觉刺激的响应之间的对齐，使我们能够更好地理解人类视觉处理过程。然而，迄今为止的研究在很大程度上忽视了一个事实：人脑不仅处理观察到的视觉刺激，还会基于已观察到的内容预测即将到来的刺激。据此，我们假设用于生成未来视频帧的内部表示比观察视频本身的表示更符合人类视觉处理的预测特性。为此，我们比较了人类观看视频时视觉皮层的fMRI响应与两类视频扩散模型（自回归（AR）模型及其非自回归基础模型）的内部表示之间的对齐程度。我们首先对AR视频扩散模型进行了模型内分析，并表明其内部表示……
tldr: 该研究发现，用于生成未来视频帧的模型内部表示比观察视频本身的表示更符合人类视觉处理的预测特性，与视觉皮层fMRI响应的对齐程度更高。
en_tdlr: Internal representations for generating future video frames align better with human visual cortex fMRI responses than representations of observed video, reflecting the predictive nature of human visual processing.
